source.provider: Hugging Face official dataset repository API

download_policy.resource_gate: Do not download while the Wave1 recovery2 controller or any project model service is active.
download_policy.transport: Download directly on the server after the resource gate; any Mac-to-server transfer must use resumable SFTP limited to 4096 Kbit/s.
download_policy.verification: Require exact revision, path set, byte count, and SHA-256 for every LFS object before any static-track lifecycle or numerical run.
download_policy.retention: Dataset files and this manifest are permanent evidence and are never model-cleanup targets.
